previewText: This is how I sound reading your pages.

sentences.text: Most of what I read happens in a browser tab, usually with three other tabs begging for attention.
Now I select a paragraph, press Read, and let a calm voice carry me through it while my eyes follow the highlight.
The speech comes from Kokoro, a small text-to-speech model that runs on my own laptop.
Nothing I read is uploaded anywhere, and it keeps working on a plane.
It also reads the messy parts the way a person would.
A €12.50 ticket on 2024-01-15, a 10GB download, a thank-you to @jane_doe and a link to https://github.com/hakubo/ReadIt all come out sounding natural.

sentences.text: Quotes get a voice of their own.
Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body.
Try another voice in the settings, change the speed, or click any sentence to jump straight to it.
